idea: Own TQQQ only for the 1-3 sessions before scheduled US market holidays, BIL otherwise, with a volatility gate.
hypothesis: A short-horizon risk premium is paid for holding equity inventory into a multi-day exchange closure; a 3x fund amplifies it.

vol_gate.lookahead: none: gate uses data through k-1

G1.note: primary: 3 sessions + 0.5 vol gate above trailing q75

G5.note: pure session exposure, no holiday gap

frontier.note: window-length scan; reported to show the family's risk-return line, not used to pick the primary
frontier.note_on_bar_clearing: only the 20-session cell clears the published bar, at 60.8% of sessions and 75.1% DD; it is not a pre-holiday strategy and the adjacent 15/25 cells give 26.6%/30.3% CAGR

random_null.note: per draw: mean open->open return of 73 random 3-session windows, same count and length as the primary

placebo.note: random start sessions, same window count and length; no filter

placebo_phase.note: generic every-Nth-session cycle, all phases; same number of non-overlapping 3-session blocks, exposure-matched

shift_test.note: every holiday anchor shifted by N sessions; same 3-session window, no filter. A genuine pre-holiday premium should peak at 0

decomposition_all_sessions.note: TQQQ on all 2016-2023 sessions: 36.5% of the log return is earned open-to-close and 63.5% close-to-open. Inside the pre-holiday windows the split flips (see event_study), so any pre-holiday premium is a session phenomenon, not an overnight one.

sensitivity_unscheduled_2018_12_05.note: adds the Bush day-of-mourning closure, not knowable in advance; not used by the primary

exposure_arithmetic.note: the strategy owns TQQQ in 10.7% of sessions, so matching a fully-invested TQQQ requires each 3-session window to compound far more than the whole sample delivered; this is why no 1-3 session cell can clear the bar

sampling_error.note: one standard error on the CAGR from window selection alone; it is larger than the whole 1-3 session CAGR range

verdict: FAIL. The pre-holiday window return is statistically indistinguishable from a random window (t=0.52; 43.5th percentile of a 4,000-draw null) and is one to two orders of magnitude too small to lift a 10.7%-of-sessions strategy to TQQQ's compounded 36.72%. The best pre-registered cell is G8 (5 sessions) at 21.21% CAGR, 15.5 points short; the best 1-3 session cell is G3 at 5.29%. Do not send to holdout.
notes: TQQQ benchmark recomputed on the same 1-minute panel is 36.15% / 82.29% / 0.80; the programme bar is 36.72% / 82.29% / 0.82.
73 scheduled holidays, 72 windows in the dev window, 216 held sessions.
The holiday list reproduces every weekday gap in the panel exactly; the only excluded closure is the unscheduled 2018-12-05.
exposure_tqqq is the mean TQQQ weight over 1-minute bars, not bt.stats' 'exposure' (which counts the BIL leg as invested).
